supports.excerpt:
The examples below were captured with two lines of code.

### Session Drilldown
Here you will find a list of all of your previously recorded sessions and useful data about each such as total execution time.
You also get helpful debugging info such as any SDK versions you were on if you're building on a supported agent framework like Crew or AutoGen.
LLM calls are presented as a familiar chat history view, and charts give you a breakdown of the types of events that were called and how long they took.

Find any past sessions from your Session Drawer.

Most powerful of all is the Session Waterfall. On the left, a time visualization of all your LLM calls, Action events, Tool calls, and Errors.
On the right, specific details about the event you've selected on the waterfall. For instance the exact prompt and completion for a given LLM call. 
Most of which has been automatically recorded for you.

### Session Overview
View a meta-analysis of all of your sessions in a single view.

skill_drafts.name: Session Drilldown Review
skill_drafts.description: Retrieve and inspect a previously recorded agent session, viewing execution timeline, LLM calls, tool invocations, errors, and performance metrics in a unified waterfall visualization.
applicable_signals: User has completed an agent run and wants to review it
Unexpected behavior observed in agent execution
contraindications: Session has not yet been recorded
User is setting up initial instrumentation
No past sessions exist in Session Drawer
intervention_moves: Inspect timeline visualization on left panel
Click event on waterfall to view details on right panel
Review LLM call prompts and completions
Examine action and tool call sequences
Identify error events and their context
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Open Session Drawer', 'detail': 'Access the list of all previously recorded sessions'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Select target session', 'detail': 'Choose the session to review from the history list'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Load Session Waterfall', 'detail': 'Open the waterfall visualization showing timeline of all events'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Review left panel timeline', 'detail': 'Examine time visualization of LLM calls, Action events, Tool calls, and Errors'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Select event for details', 'detail': 'Click any event on the waterfall to view specific details on right panel'}
{'step': 6, 'action': 'Analyze event details', 'detail': 'Review exact prompt, completion, timing, and other metadata for selected event'}
triggers: User needs to review a past agent run
User wants to troubleshoot unexpected behavior
User needs to analyze performance bottlenecks
User requests inspection of recorded session metrics
constraints: Session must have been previously recorded with AgentOps instrumentation
SDK must be on a supported agent framework (Crew, AutoGen, or equivalent)
Session data must be available in the Session Drawer
cautions: Large sessions with many events may take time to load and render
Event details are automatically recorded; verify data completeness before analysis
output_contract: Session waterfall view loaded with complete timeline of all LLM calls, actions, tool calls, and errors; selected event details displayed in right panel; session metadata including total execution time and SDK versions visible; user can navigate and inspect any recorded event.

metadata.prompt: Open the Session Drawer to find a past session. Load the Session Waterfall view. On the left, examine the time visualization of all LLM calls, Action events, Tool calls, and Errors. On the right, select any event to view its specific details such as exact prompt and completion for LLM calls. Review session metadata including total execution time and SDK versions.

skill_drafts.name: Session Overview Meta-Analysis
skill_drafts.description: Aggregate and display summary statistics and trends across all recorded sessions in a single consolidated view for high-level performance and behavior pattern analysis.
contraindications: User is investigating a specific session incident
User needs granular event-level or prompt-completion details
User requires drill-down into individual LLM calls or tool execution
workflow_steps: Retrieve metadata and summary statistics for all recorded sessions
Compute cross-session metrics: total execution time, event type distribution, error frequency, success rates
Identify trends and patterns in agent behavior across runs
Render aggregated metrics and comparative visualizations in a single consolidated dashboard
triggers: User requests trend analysis across multiple agent runs
User wants to compare performance metrics between sessions
User seeks high-level overview of overall agent behavior patterns
constraints: Requires at least two recorded sessions to generate meaningful comparative statistics
Aggregation must preserve session isolation; do not merge event sequences across sessions
output_contract: Meta-analysis dashboard displaying aggregated metrics, trends, and comparative statistics across all sessions; user can identify performance patterns and behavioral trends without navigating individual session details.

metadata.prompt: Retrieve all recorded sessions and compute cross-session metrics including execution time distributions, event type frequencies, error rates, and performance trends. Present aggregated data in a unified dashboard that enables comparison of agent behavior patterns across multiple runs without requiring drill-down into individual session details.

skill_drafts.name: Event Timeline Waterfall Navigation
skill_drafts.description: Interact with a time-ordered waterfall visualization of LLM calls, action events, tool calls, and errors. Select individual events to view detailed prompt, completion, and metadata for inspection and debugging.
applicable_signals: User has a specific LLM call, action event, tool call, or error to investigate
contraindications: User is looking for aggregate statistics across events
User is seeking cross-session patterns or comparisons
User needs high-level session overview rather than event-level detail
workflow_steps: Locate the waterfall visualization with time-ordered events on the left panel
Identify the target event (LLM call, action event, tool call, or error) in the timeline
Observe the right-side panel populate with event details
triggers: User has identified a specific time window or event type of interest
User needs to examine exact prompts, completions, or error messages
User is reviewing a recorded session and wants to drill into individual events
constraints: Event must exist in the waterfall visualization
Session must have been previously recorded
Event selection requires interactive UI interaction
output_contract: Right-side panel displays exact prompt, completion, timestamps, and metadata for the selected event. Output includes full event context automatically recorded by the system.

metadata.prompt: On the waterfall visualization, locate the event of interest in the time-ordered list on the left. Click or select the event. The right-side panel will display exact prompt, completion, timestamps, and metadata for that event. Use this to inspect error messages, review exact LLM prompts and completions, or examine tool call details.
